items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Sid Catlett was a friend of mine and a very marvelous musician

ctx.x: Well, he started on piano. I wanted so badly, I suppose like most people in music, you know. I

don't -- you know, I don't say that I would have wanted him to be a professional musician, you know. That would be up to him to choose this, and I think this is the way it should be with any child. I don't think you should just force it on him. But I was hoping that he would have been musical, you know, would have liked music enough to stick with it. And he loved it, and he still does, you know. And he could get to the piano and he would pick out little things on the piano, you know, and I was so thrilled. I…
